user.title: Add an Arylic LP-series player
user.description: Enter the player's IP address. Players on the same network as Home Assistant are discovered automatically, and their address is kept up to date.

power.title: Speaker power
power.description: Choose the plug that powers {name}'s speakers. Auto-power switches it on when playback starts, and off after a set time with nothing playing.

data_description.power_switch: Any switch, light or input_boolean. Leave empty to use play state and controls only. You can link a plug later on the player's device page.
data_description.airplay_fallback: Also treats an active AirPlay session as playing. Recommended.

reconfigure.title: Change IP address
reconfigure.description: Enter the player's new IP address.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the player's control port (TCP 2018). Check the IP address, and that Home Assistant can reach the player's network.
error.invalid_host: Enter a valid IP address or host name.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Check the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.already_configured: This player is already set up. If its address had changed, it has been updated.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The player's address has been updated.
abort.different_device: That address belongs to a different player.

init.title: Speaker power
init.description: The plug that powers the speakers, and how playback is detected. Both settings are also on the player's device page.

data_description.power_switch: Any switch, light or input_boolean. Leave empty to turn auto-power off.
data_description.airplay_fallback: Also treats an active AirPlay session as playing. Recommended.

only_own.name: Auto-off only if auto-on turned it on

unreachable.title: {name} is unreachable
unreachable.description: Home Assistant has not been able to reach the player at {host} for over 10 minutes. Check it is powered and on the network. If its IP address changed, use Reconfigure on the integration. While it is unreachable, auto-power waits at least 60 minutes before switching the speakers off.

power_failed.title: Could not {action} {switch}
power_failed.description: Auto-power tried several times to {action} {switch} but it did not respond ({error}). Check the plug is online.
